Name: Clement
Summary: Clement was a fellowlabourer with Paul at Philippi whose name, Paul says, is in the book of life. He is traditionally, but not certainly, identified with Clement of Rome.
KeyStory: Clement was a fellowlabourer with Paul at Philippi whose name, Paul says, is in the book of life. He is traditionally, but not certainly, identified with Clement of Rome.
LifeLesson: Labouring in the gospel is recorded where it matters most, in the book of life.
